title: EvidenceTune parsed action
description: What the model did with the feedback, parsed from its raw output.

answer.description: The answer the model gives this turn (null when it only asks a question).

citation.description: Span ID(s) cited, e.g. "S2". Expected for update and retain.

clarification_question.description: The targeted evidence request. Required when action is clarify.

parse_ok.description: False if the parser fell back to a default.
